subject.title: feat(gateway): land remaining durable-approvals stack and repair main gates

question: Should existing plugins that set `requireApproval.timeoutBehavior: "allow"` retain that behavior during the deprecation window, or should this PR intentionally enforce an immediate fail-closed cutover?
rationale: The public field remains accepted, so the correct repair requires an explicit choice between a shipped plugin compatibility contract and immediate fail-closed execution policy.

options.title: Preserve through deprecation
options.body: Continue honoring `timeoutBehavior: "allow"` during the documented deprecation window while warning plugin authors and keeping malformed, missing, mismatched, and disallowed verdicts fail-closed.

options.title: Cut over fail-closed now
options.body: Ignore the field immediately with explicit owner acceptance of the breaking upgrade behavior and corresponding communication and proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve through deprecation
recommendation.body: Continue honoring `timeoutBehavior: "allow"` during the documented deprecation window while warning plugin authors and keeping malformed, missing, mismatched, and disallowed verdicts fail-closed.
